decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the firm’s core instrument business and already featured on the home page, it reflects visible commitment and likely meaningful investment, so management would be inclined to continue backing it rather than admit an early reversal.

Because this oncology risk-management software builds on the established QA offering and the firm is expanding in a growing, R&D-intensive market, management would likely keep it and interpret any early-market weakness as temporary despite a slightly higher withdrawal risk than for the more central hardware product.
